items.title: Barra Velha (SC) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 2 #PRI 75
items.en_title: Barra Velha (SC) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 2 #PRI 75
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Barra Velha (SC) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 1,920,000; proposals close Dec 2, 13:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
